title: The East Australian Current and where it leaves the coast
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness for 2011-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), characterize the East Australian Current: its position, strength and vertical structure through the seasonal cycle, the latitude at which it separates from the coast, how these changed from year to year, and what controls the changes.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
